source.text: שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹא־חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ־מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Judge me, God, and plead my case against a nation not faithful; from a man of deceit and injustice rescue me.

en.L: Judge me, God, and plead my case against a nation not faithful; from the {{gender:person|man}} of deceit and injustice rescue me.
en.B: Give judgment for me, God, and take up my case against a nation without loyalty; save me from people who lie and do wrong.
en.R: God, show that I am right. Defend me against people who are not loyal to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Save me from people who lie and are unfair.

fr.L: Juge-moi, ô Dieu, et plaide ma cause contre une nation sans fidélité ; de {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} de tromperie et d’injustice délivre-moi.
fr.B: Rends-moi justice, ô Dieu, et défends ma cause contre une nation sans loyauté ; sauve-moi des gens qui mentent et font le mal.
fr.R: Dieu, montre que je suis dans mon droit. Défends-moi contre ceux qui ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sont pas fidèles. Sauve-moi des gens qui mentent et qui sont injustes.

sw.L: Unihukumu, Mungu, na unitetee shauri langu dhidi ya taifa lisilo na uaminifu; kutoka kwa mtu wa hila na udhalimu uniokoe.
sw.B: Unitolee hukumu, Mungu, na ulichukue shauri langu dhidi ya taifa lisilo na uaminifu; uniokoe kutoka kwa watu waongo na watenda mabaya.
sw.R: Mungu, onyesha kwamba niko sahihi. Unitetee dhidi ya watu wasio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}. Uniokoe kutoka kwa watu waongo na wasio wa haki.

es.L: Júzgame, oh Dios, y defiende mi causa contra una nación sin lealtad; de {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} de engaño e injusticia líbrame.
es.B: Dicta sentencia a mi favor, oh Dios, y toma mi causa contra una nación sin lealtad; sálvame de la gente que miente y hace el mal.
es.R: Dios, demuestra que tengo la razón. Defiéndeme contra la gente que no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} es leal. Sálvame de la gente que miente y es injusta.

vi.L: Xin xét xử tôi, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, và binh vực duyên cớ tôi chống lại một dân không trung tín; khỏi người dối trá và bất công, xin giải cứu tôi.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin xét xử cho tôi và đứng ra bênh vực tôi chống lại một dân không có lòng trung tín; xin cứu tôi khỏi những kẻ dối trá và làm điều bất công.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, xin cho thấy tôi là người ngay. Xin bênh vực tôi chống lại những kẻ không trung thành với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin cứu tôi khỏi những kẻ nói dối và bất công.

ko.L: 저를 판단해 주십시오, 하나님. 신실하지 않은 민족을 거슬러 제 송사를 변호해 주십시오. 속이고 불의한 사람에게서 저를 건져 주십시오.
ko.B: 하나님, 저를 위해 판결해 주시고, 신의 없는 민족을 상대로 제 송사를 맡아 주십시오. 거짓말하고 악을 행하는 사람들에게서 저를 구해 주십시오.
ko.R: 하나님, 제가 옳다는 것을 밝혀 주십시오. 주님께 신실하지 않은 사람들에게서 저를 변호해 주십시오. 거짓말하고 불공정한 사람들에게서 저를 구해 주십시오.

pt.L: Julga-me, ó Deus, e defende a minha causa contra uma nação infiel; {{gender:da pessoa|do homem}} de engano e de injustiça livra-me.
pt.B: Julga a meu favor, ó Deus, e assume a minha causa contra uma nação sem lealdade; livra-me das pessoas que mentem e praticam o mal.
pt.R: Ó Deus, mostra que eu estou certo. Defende-me contra as pessoas que não são leais a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Salva-me das pessoas que mentem e são injustas.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ፍረድልኝ፤ ታማኝ ካልሆነ ሕዝብ ጋር ያለኝን ክርክር ተሟገትልኝ፤ ከአታላይና ከዓመፀኛ ሰው አድነኝ።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ፍርድ ስጥልኝ፤ ታማኝነት በሌለው ሕዝብ ፊት ጉዳዬን ያዝልኝ፤ ከሚዋሹና ግፍ ከሚሠሩ ሰዎች አድነኝ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ትክክለኛ መሆኔን አሳይ። ለአንተ ታማኝ ካልሆኑ ሰዎች ተከላከልልኝ። ከሚዋሹና ፍትሕ ከሚያጓድሉ ሰዎች አድነኝ።

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, मेरा न्याय कर, और ऐसी जाति के विरुद्ध मेरा मुक़दमा लड़ जो भक्त नहीं; छल और अन्याय करनेवाले {{gender:व्यक्ति|पुरुष}} से मुझे छुड़ा।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, मेरे पक्ष में न्याय कर, और निष्ठाहीन राष्ट्र के विरुद्ध मेरा मुक़दमा अपने हाथ में ले; झूठ बोलनेवाले और बुरा करनेवाले लोगों से मुझे बचा।
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, दिखा दे कि मैं सही हूँ। उन लोगों के विरुद्ध मेरा बचाव कर जो तेरे प्रति वफ़ादार नहीं हैं। मुझे उन लोगों से बचा जो झूठ बोलते हैं और अन्याय करते हैं।

ru.L: Суди меня, Боже, и веди моё дело против народа неверного; от человека лжи и неправды избавь меня.
ru.B: Боже, рассуди меня и защити моё дело против народа, в котором нет верности; спаси меня от людей, которые лгут и творят зло.
ru.R: Боже, покажи, что я прав. Защити меня от людей, которые не верны {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Спаси меня от тех, кто лжёт и поступает нечестно.

ja.L: わたしを裁いてください、神よ。誠実でない国民に対して、わたしの訴えを弁護してください。欺きと不正の人から、わたしを助け出してください。
ja.B: 神よ、わたしのために裁きを行い、誠実のない民に対して、わたしの訴えを取り上げてください。偽りを語り、不正を行う人々から、わたしを助け出してください。
ja.R: 神よ、わたしが正しいことを示してください。あなたに忠実でない人々から、わたしを守ってください。うそをつき、不公平なことをする人々から、わたしを助け出してください。

uk.L: Розсуди мене, Боже, і обстань за мою справу проти народу невірного; від {{gender:людини|чоловіка}} підступу й неправди визволи мене.
uk.B: Винеси присуд на мою користь, Боже, і візьмися за мою справу проти народу без вірності; спаси мене від людей, які брешуть і чинять кривду.
uk.R: Боже, покажи, що я правий. Захисти мене від людей, які не вірні {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}. Спаси мене від людей, які брешуть і чинять несправедливо.

decisions.reason: This psalm has no title and shares the refrain of Psalm 42 (verse 5; 42:6, 12), so it is the last part of the same poem. Here the complaint turns to prayer.

decisions.choice: judge me, plead my case: take my side in court
decisions.reason: He asks God to act as judge and as his advocate, and so to clear him (7:9; 26:1; 35:1).
The word (chasid) is the one of 4:4; a nation without it keeps no faith with God or others.
The phrase is general: anyone deceitful and unjust.
Balanced and Readable speak of such people as a group.
Readable says to whom they are not loyal (m3).

decisions.choice: Psalm 43 continues Psalm 42: the prayer (verses 1-4) is 합쇼체 with "저", and the refrain (verse 5) speaks to "내 영혼아" in 해라체 with the same words as 42:6 and 42:12
alternatives: a new speech pattern for Psalm 43
decisions.reason: The two psalms are one poem (meaning decision m1), so the Korean keeps the levels set at Psalm 42.

decisions.choice: da pessoa, with "do homem" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the English: the phrase means anyone deceitful and unjust. The article changes with the noun, so the whole phrase "da pessoa" / "do homem" is under the setting.
The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: The English offers an inclusive and a traditional wording here. The Amharic word (ሰው, የሰው ልጆች, or the generic singular suffix) already speaks of men and women alike, so there is no second wording to offer and no span (docs/amharic-style.md 7b). This holds for the rest of the psalm.
As in the English, the phrase means anyone deceitful and unjust: व्यक्ति (person), with पुरुष (man) as the alternative.

alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans, as in English
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters; God is set apart by तू in address and honorific forms in the third person, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans in this psalm.
At Balanced and Readable a nation is राष्ट्र or देश, not जाति, which can also mean caste; Literal keeps जाति, as the poetry note has it.

Hasid, one who keeps loyal love (m3), is भक्त at Literal throughout Psalms 42-72 (50:5; 52:11), so the nation that is "not hasid" is one that is not भक्त. Balanced and Readable say what it lacks, loyalty.
The English Literal has "person" with "man" as the alternative. Russian "человек" already means anyone, man or woman, so no setting is needed (as the style guide says for человек).
Psalm 43 continues Psalm 42 (m1); it keeps its wording for the repeated lines (43:2 = 42:10) and the refrain (43:5).

decisions.choice: No gender span: "人" (L), "人々" (B, R) for the English {{gender:person|man}}; goy lo-chasid "誠実でない国民" (L), "誠実のない民" (B), "あなたに忠実でない人々" (R)
decisions.reason: Japanese 人 already covers men and women (PSA-1). chasid by the Psalter's forms (誠実 L, B; 忠実 R), without loyal love (m3); a plea in court (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה׀אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָֽעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֪ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For you [are the] God of my stronghold; why have you rejected me? Why mourning do I go about in [the] oppression of an enemy?

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are] the God of my stronghold; why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rejected me? Why do I walk about mourning under the oppression of an enemy?
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are God, my fortress. Why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pushed me away? Why do I walk about dressed in grief while the enemy presses me hard?
en.R: You are God, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me safe. So why have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turned me away? Why am I so sad? Why do my enemies treat me so badly?

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] le Dieu de ma forteresse ; pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rejeté ? Pourquoi vais-je en deuil sous l’oppression d’un ennemi ?
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es Dieu, ma forteresse. Pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} repoussé ? Pourquoi dois-je aller vêtu de deuil, pendant que l’ennemi m’écrase ?
fr.R: Tu es Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me protèges. Alors pourquoi m’as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} repoussé ? Pourquoi suis-je si triste ? Pourquoi mes ennemis me font-ils tant de mal ?

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ni] Mungu wa ngome yangu; kwa nini umenikataa? Kwa nini ninatembea nikiomboleza chini ya uonevu wa adui?
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Mungu, ngome yangu. Kwa nini umenisukuma mbali? Kwa nini ninatembea nimevaa huzuni huku adui akinikandamiza?
sw.R: Wewe ni Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} hunilinda salama. Basi kwa nini umenikataa? Kwa nini nina huzuni hivi? Kwa nini adui zangu wananitendea vibaya hivi?

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres] el Dios de mi fortaleza; ¿por qué me has rechazado? ¿Por qué ando enlutado bajo la opresión del enemigo?
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios, mi fortaleza. ¿Por qué me has apartado de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}? ¿Por qué ando vestido de luto mientras el enemigo me oprime?
es.R: Tú eres Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me mantienes a salvo. Entonces, ¿por qué me has rechazado? ¿Por qué estoy tan triste? ¿Por qué mis enemigos me tratan tan mal?

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời, đồn lũy của tôi; sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ruồng bỏ tôi? Sao tôi phải đi lại than khóc dưới sự áp bức của kẻ thù?
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, là đồn lũy của tôi. Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xua đuổi tôi? Sao tôi phải đi lại trong áo tang, trong khi kẻ thù ép bức tôi?
vi.R: Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ tôi an toàn. Vậy sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại xua đuổi tôi? Sao tôi buồn rầu đến thế? Sao kẻ thù lại đối xử tệ với tôi như vậy?

ko.L: 참으로 주님은 제 요새의 하나님이십니다. 어찌하여 저를 버리셨습니까? 어찌하여 제가 원수의 억압 아래 슬퍼하며 다녀야 합니까?
ko.B: 주님은 저의 요새이신 하나님이십니다. 어찌하여 저를 밀어내셨습니까? 어찌하여 제가 원수에게 짓눌려 슬픔의 옷을 입고 다녀야 합니까?
ko.R: 주님은 저를 안전하게 지켜 주시는 하나님이십니다. 그런데 어찌하여 저를 멀리하셨습니까? 저는 왜 이렇게 슬퍼야 합니까? 제 원수들은 왜 저를 이렇게 괴롭힙니까?

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [és] o Deus da minha fortaleza; por que me rejeitaste? Por que ando de luto sob a opressão do inimigo?
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus, a minha fortaleza. Por que me afastaste de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}? Por que ando vestido de luto, enquanto o inimigo me aperta?
pt.R: Tu és Deus e me guardas em segurança. Então por que me rejeitaste? Por que estou tão triste? Por que os meus inimigos me tratam tão mal?

am.L: አንተ የምሽጌ አምላክ ነህና፤ ለምን ጣልከኝ? በጠላት ግፍ ለምን እያዘንኩ እመላለሳለሁ?
am.B: አንተ ምሽጌ የሆንከው አምላክ ነህና። ለምን ገፋኸኝ? ጠላት እያስጨነቀኝ ለምን የሐዘን ልብስ ለብሼ እመላለሳለሁ?
am.R: አንተ እግዚአብሔር ነህ፤ ተጠብቄ እንድኖርም ታደርገኛለህ። ታዲያ ለምን ተውከኝ? ለምን እንዲህ አዝኛለሁ? ጠላቶቼስ ለምን እንዲህ ያንገላቱኛል?

hi.L: क्योंकि तू ही मेरे गढ़ का परमेश्वर [है]; तूने मुझे क्यों त्याग दिया? मैं शत्रु के अत्याचार के नीचे शोक करता हुआ क्यों फिरता हूँ?
hi.B: क्योंकि तू ही परमेश्वर है, मेरा गढ़। तूने मुझे क्यों दूर धकेल दिया? जब शत्रु मुझे कड़ाई से दबाता है, तब मैं शोक के वस्त्र पहने क्यों फिरता हूँ?
hi.R: तू ही परमेश्वर है, और तू मुझे सुरक्षित रखता है। तो फिर तूने मुझे क्यों ठुकरा दिया? मैं इतना उदास क्यों हूँ? मेरे शत्रु मुझसे इतना बुरा व्यवहार क्यों करते हैं?

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — Бог крепости моей; почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} отверг меня? Почему я хожу в скорби под гнётом врага?
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — Бог, моя крепость. Почему {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} оттолкнул меня? Почему я хожу в траурной одежде, а враг теснит меня?
ru.R: Ты — Бог, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} хранишь меня. Почему же {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} отвернулся от меня? Почему мне так плохо? Почему враги так жестоко обращаются со мной?

ja.L: まことに、あなたはわたしの砦の神。なぜ、あなたはわたしをお拒みになったのか？なぜ、わたしは敵の虐げのもとで、嘆きながら歩き回るのか？
ja.B: あなたは、わたしの砦である神だ。なぜ、わたしを突き放してしまわれたのか？なぜ、わたしは嘆きの衣をまとって歩き回るのか？敵がわたしを激しく苦しめているのに。
ja.R: あなたは神、わたしを守ってくださる方だ。それなのに、なぜ、わたしを追い払ってしまわれたのか？なぜ、わたしはこんなに悲しいのか？なぜ、敵はわたしをこんなにひどく扱うのか？

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — Бог моєї твердині; чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відкинув мене? Чому я ходжу в жалобі під гнобленням ворога?
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — Бог, моя фортеця. Чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відштовхнув мене? Чому я ходжу, зодягнений у журбу, а ворог тяжко тисне на мене?
uk.R: Ти — Бог, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} бережеш мене. То чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відвернувся від мене? Чому мені так сумно? Чому мої вороги так погано поводяться зі мною?

decisions.choice: my stronghold: my place of refuge
decisions.reason: The word (ma'oz) is a fortress, a strong place to flee to (27:1; 31:5).
The question repeats 42:10, with "rejected" in place of "forgotten". The same wording is used at each level.
The verb (zanach) is to cast off or spurn (44:10, 24).

decisions.choice: the second question worded as in 42:10
decisions.reason: The question repeats 42:10 (m2), so each level repeats the Portuguese of 42:10 word for word: "Por que ando de luto sob a opressão do inimigo?" (L), "Por que ando vestido de luto, enquanto o inimigo me aperta?" (B).

decisions.choice: the second question in the same Amharic as 42:10 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 42:10 here (see the meaning decision), so the Amharic does too.

The question "Why do I walk about mourning under the oppression of an enemy?" repeats 42:10 word for word in the Hebrew, so each level keeps the wording it has there. Only the first question differs (rejected, त्याग दिया, for forgotten).
The Hebrew repeats 42:10 (m2), so each level repeats its wording there.

decisions.choice: ma'uzzi "わたしの砦" (L, B), "わたしを守ってくださる方" (R); the last question word for word as 42:10
decisions.reason: ma'oz 砦 (L, B), 守り (R) as the Psalter's refuge words (PSA-1); the line repeats 42:10 (m2), so the Japanese repeats it too.

source.text: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־הַֽר־קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Send your light and your truth; they will lead me; they will bring me to [the] mountain of your holiness and to your dwellings.

en.L: Send out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} light and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy mountain and to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling places.
en.B: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} light and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth go out to guide me; may they lead me up to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy mountain, to the place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live.
en.R: Send {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} light and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth to show me the way. Let them lead me back to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy mountain, to the place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live.

fr.L: Envoie {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lumière et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité ; qu’elles me conduisent ; qu’elles m’amènent à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} montagne sainte et à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} demeures.
fr.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lumière et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité partent me guider ; qu’elles me fassent monter jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} montagne sainte, au lieu où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites.
fr.R: Envoie {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lumière et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité pour me montrer le chemin. Qu’elles me ramènent à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} montagne sainte, à l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites.

sw.L: Uitume nuru {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; zinitangulie; zinilete kwenye mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mtakatifu na kwenye maskani {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Nuru {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} zitoke ziniongoze; zinipandishe hadi mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mtakatifu, mahali unapoishi.
sw.R: Utume nuru {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} zinionyeshe njia. Ziniongoze kurudi kwenye mlima {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mtakatifu, mahali unapoishi.

es.L: Envía {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} luz y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad; que ellas me guíen; que me lleven a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo monte y a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} moradas.
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} luz y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad salgan a guiarme; que me lleven hasta {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo monte, al lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives.
es.R: Envía {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} luz y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad para que me muestren el camino. Que me lleven de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo monte, al lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives.

vi.L: Xin sai ánh sáng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra; nguyện chúng dẫn tôi; nguyện chúng đưa tôi đến núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và đến những nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin cho ánh sáng và chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi ra dẫn đường cho tôi; nguyện chúng dẫn tôi lên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.
vi.R: Xin sai ánh sáng và chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến chỉ đường cho tôi. Xin cho chúng dẫn tôi trở về núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở.

ko.L: 주님의 빛과 주님의 진실을 보내 주십시오. 그것들이 저를 인도하게 하시고, 주님의 거룩한 산과 주님께서 계시는 곳으로 저를 데려가게 하십시오.
ko.B: 주님의 빛과 진실을 보내셔서 저를 이끌게 하시고, 주님의 거룩한 산, 주님께서 계시는 곳으로 저를 데려가게 하십시오.
ko.R: 주님의 빛과 진실을 보내 주셔서 저에게 길을 보여 주십시오. 그것들이 저를 주님의 거룩한 산, 주님께서 계시는 곳으로 다시 데려가게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Envia a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} luz e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade; que elas me conduzam, que me tragam ao monte da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} santidade e às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} moradas.
pt.B: Que a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} luz e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade saiam para me guiar; que elas me conduzam ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo monte, ao lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habitas.
pt.R: Manda a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} luz e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade para me mostrar o caminho. Que elas me levem de volta ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo monte, ao lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} moras.

am.L: ብርሃንህንና እውነትህን ላክ፤ እነርሱ ይምሩኝ፤ ወደ ተቀደሰው ተራራህና ወደ ማደሪያዎችህ ያድርሱኝ።
am.B: ይመሩኝ ዘንድ ብርሃንህና እውነትህ ይውጡ፤ ወደ ተቀደሰው ተራራህ፣ ወደምትኖርበት ስፍራ ያውጡኝ።
am.R: መንገዱን እንዲያሳዩኝ ብርሃንህንና እውነትህን ላክ። ወደ ተቀደሰው ተራራህ፣ ወደምትኖርበት ስፍራ መልሰው ይውሰዱኝ።

hi.L: अपना प्रकाश और अपना सत्य भेज; वे मेरी अगुवाई करें; वे मुझे तेरे पवित्र पर्वत पर और तेरे निवासस्थानों तक पहुँचाएँ।
hi.B: तेरा प्रकाश और तेरा सत्य मेरा मार्गदर्शन करने को निकलें; वे मुझे तेरे पवित्र पर्वत पर, उस स्थान तक ले चलें जहाँ तू रहता है।
hi.R: अपना प्रकाश और अपना सत्य भेज कि वे मुझे रास्ता दिखाएँ। वे मुझे वापस तेरे पवित्र पर्वत पर ले चलें, उस स्थान पर जहाँ तू रहता है।

ru.L: Пошли свет {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} и истину {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}}; пусть они ведут меня, пусть приведут меня на гору святости {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} и к жилищам {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}}.
ru.B: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} свет и {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} истина выйдут, чтобы вести меня; пусть они приведут меня на {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} святую гору, туда, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} живёшь.
ru.R: Пошли {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} свет и {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} истину, чтобы они показали мне дорогу. Пусть они приведут меня обратно на {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} святую гору, туда, где {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} живёшь.

ja.L: あなたの光とあなたのまことを送ってください。それらがわたしを導くように。それらがわたしを、あなたの聖なる山、あなたの住まいへと連れて行くように。
ja.B: あなたの光とまことを送り出して、わたしを導かせてください。それらがわたしを、あなたの聖なる山へ、あなたの住まわれる所へと連れて上るように。
ja.R: あなたの光と真実を送って、わたしに道を示してください。それらがわたしを、あなたの聖なる山へ、あなたが住んでおられる所へと、連れ戻してくれるように。

uk.L: Пошли {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} світло й {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} істину; нехай вони ведуть мене; нехай приведуть мене до {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} святої гори й до {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} осель.
uk.B: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} світло й {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} істина вийдуть, щоб провадити мене; нехай вони приведуть мене на {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} святу гору, до місця, де {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} живеш.
uk.R: Пошли {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} світло й {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} правду, щоб показати мені дорогу. Нехай вони приведуть мене назад до {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} святої гори, до місця, де {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} живеш.

decisions.choice: your light and your truth: God's guides sent ahead
decisions.reason: Light and truth are pictured as two messengers God sends to bring the exile home, as his loyal love goes out in 42:9 (compare 57:4).

decisions.choice: your holy mountain: Zion, where the temple stood
decisions.reason: As in 2:6 and 3:5. This answers the longing of 42:3.
The plural (mishkenot) is the dwelling of God, the sanctuary (84:2).
Readable makes clear that he is returning (42:5).

decisions.choice: 'amittekha "あなたのまこと" (L, B), "真実" (R); mishkenotekha "あなたの住まい" (L), "あなたの住まわれる所" (B)
decisions.reason: 'emet まこと (L, B), 真実 (R) by the Psalter's key words; light and truth are guides God sends ahead (m1).

source.text: וְאָב֤וֹאָה׀אֶל־מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will come to [the] altar of God, to God, [the] joy of my rejoicing, and I will give thanks to you with [the] lyre, God, my God.

en.L: And I will come to the altar of God, to God, the joy of my rejoicing, and I will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with [the] lyre, God, my God.
en.B: Then I will come up to God's altar, to God, who is my gladness and my joy, and with the lyre I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, God, my God.
en.R: Then I will go to God's altar. God makes me so very happy! I will play the harp and thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God, my God.

fr.L: Et je viendrai à l’autel de Dieu, à Dieu, la joie de mon allégresse, et je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce avec [la] lyre, ô Dieu, mon Dieu.
fr.B: Alors je monterai à l’autel de Dieu, vers Dieu, qui est ma joie et mon allégresse, et sur la lyre je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce, ô Dieu, mon Dieu.
fr.R: Alors j’irai à l’autel de Dieu. Dieu me rend tellement heureux ! Je jouerai de la harpe et je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai, ô Dieu, mon Dieu.

sw.L: Nami nitakuja kwenye madhabahu ya Mungu, kwa Mungu, furaha ya shangwe yangu, nami nitakushukuru kwa kinubi, Mungu, Mungu wangu.
sw.B: Ndipo nitakapopanda kwenye madhabahu ya Mungu, kwa Mungu aliye furaha yangu na shangwe yangu, nami nitakushukuru kwa kinubi, Mungu, Mungu wangu.
sw.R: Ndipo nitakapokwenda kwenye madhabahu ya Mungu. Mungu hunifurahisha sana! Nitapiga kinubi na kukushukuru, Mungu, Mungu wangu.

es.L: Y llegaré al altar de Dios, a Dios, la alegría de mi gozo, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias con [la] lira, oh Dios, Dios mío.
es.B: Entonces subiré al altar de Dios, a Dios, que es mi alegría y mi gozo, y con la lira {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias, oh Dios, Dios mío.
es.R: Entonces iré al altar de Dios. ¡Dios me hace muy feliz! Tocaré el arpa y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias, oh Dios, Dios mío.

vi.L: Và tôi sẽ đến bàn thờ của Đức Chúa Trời, đến cùng Đức Chúa Trời, niềm vui của sự hân hoan tôi, và tôi sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng đàn lia, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.B: Bấy giờ tôi sẽ đến bàn thờ Đức Chúa Trời, đến cùng Đức Chúa Trời là niềm vui và sự hân hoan của tôi, và tôi sẽ gảy đàn lia cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.R: Bấy giờ tôi sẽ đến bàn thờ của Đức Chúa Trời. Đức Chúa Trời làm cho tôi vui mừng biết bao! Tôi sẽ gảy đàn hạc và cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.

ko.L: 그러면 제가 하나님의 제단으로, 저의 큰 기쁨이신 하나님께로 나아가, 수금으로 주님께 감사하겠습니다, 하나님, 저의 하나님.
ko.B: 그러면 제가 하나님의 제단으로, 저의 기쁨이요 즐거움이신 하나님께로 올라가서, 수금을 타며 주님께 감사하겠습니다, 하나님, 저의 하나님.
ko.R: 그러면 제가 하나님의 제단으로 가겠습니다. 하나님은 저를 정말 기쁘게 하시는 분이십니다! 하나님, 저의 하나님, 제가 수금을 타며 주님께 감사하겠습니다.

pt.L: E irei ao altar de Deus, a Deus, a alegria do meu júbilo, e {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças com [a] lira, ó Deus, meu Deus.
pt.B: Então subirei ao altar de Deus, a Deus, que é a minha alegria e o meu júbilo, e com a lira {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} darei graças, ó Deus, meu Deus.
pt.R: Então irei até o altar de Deus. Deus me deixa tão feliz! Vou tocar a harpa e {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecer, ó Deus, meu Deus.

am.L: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም መሠዊያ እገባለሁ፤ የደስታዬ ሐሤት ወደ ሆነው ወደ እግዚአብሔር፤ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ አምላኬ፣ በበገና አመሰግንሃለሁ።
am.B: ከዚያም ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ፣ ደስታዬና ሐሤቴ ወደ ሆነው ወደ እግዚአብሔር እወጣለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ አምላኬ ሆይ፣ በበገና አመሰግንሃለሁ።
am.R: ከዚያም ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ እሄዳለሁ። እግዚአብሔር እጅግ ደስ ያሰኘኛል! እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ አምላኬ ሆይ፣ በገና እየደረደርኩ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

hi.L: और मैं परमेश्वर की वेदी के पास जाऊँगा, परमेश्वर के पास, जो मेरे आनंद का हर्ष हैं; और हे परमेश्वर, मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं वीणा के साथ तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा।
hi.B: तब मैं परमेश्वर की वेदी के पास जाऊँगा, उस परमेश्वर के पास जो मेरा आनंद और मेरा हर्ष हैं; और हे परमेश्वर, मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं वीणा बजाकर तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा।
hi.R: तब मैं परमेश्वर की वेदी के पास जाऊँगा। परमेश्वर मुझे बहुत ही आनंदित करते हैं! हे परमेश्वर, मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं वीणा बजाऊँगा और तेरा धन्यवाद करूँगा।

ru.L: И приду я к жертвеннику Божьему, к Богу, радости ликования моего, и буду благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} на лире, Боже, Боже мой.
ru.B: Тогда я приду к Божьему жертвеннику, к Богу, моей радости и веселью, и под звуки лиры буду благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, Боже, Боже мой.
ru.R: Тогда я пойду к Божьему жертвеннику. Бог даёт мне такую радость! Я буду играть на арфе и благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, Боже, Боже мой.

ja.L: そして、わたしは神の祭壇へ、わたしの喜びの楽しみである神のもとへ行き、竪琴であなたに感謝しよう、神よ、わたしの神よ。
ja.B: そのとき、わたしは神の祭壇へ、わたしの喜び、わたしの楽しみである神のもとへ上り、竪琴に合わせて、あなたに感謝する。神よ、わたしの神よ。
ja.R: そのとき、わたしは神の祭壇へ行く。神は、わたしをこんなにも喜ばせてくださる！神よ、わたしの神よ、わたしはたて琴をひいて、あなたに感謝する。

uk.L: І я прийду до Божого жертовника, до Бога, радості мого веселощів, і дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} на лірі, Боже, мій Боже.
uk.B: Тоді я прийду до Божого жертовника, до Бога, який — моя втіха й моя радість, і на лірі дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, Боже, мій Боже.
uk.R: Тоді я піду до Божого жертовника. Бог робить мене таким щасливим! Я гратиму на лірі й дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, Боже, мій Боже.

decisions.choice: the joy of my rejoicing: my greatest joy
decisions.reason: Two words for joy are joined to say that God is his joy above all.

decisions.choice: the lyre: a small stringed instrument
decisions.reason: The kinnor was a hand-held lyre, played to accompany songs of praise (33:2).
Readable uses the better-known word for a stringed instrument plucked by hand.

decisions.choice: the lyre (kinnor) as "በገና" at every level
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 15:21 on main, where the kinnor is "በገና" and the nevel (harp) "መሰንቆ"; the English Readable's "harp" is the same instrument.
The kinnor, a small hand-plucked lyre, is वीणा at every level; the word is familiar in Hindi, so Readable keeps it where the English changes "lyre" to "harp".
The Levites' instrument words as 1 Chronicles (1CH-consistency); a small stringed instrument (m2).

source.text: מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י׀נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to him, [the] salvation of my face and my God.

en.L: Why are you bowed down, my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Wait for God, for I will yet give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, the salvation of my face and my God.
en.B: Why are you bent so low, my soul? Why this unrest inside me? Wait for God in hope; I will give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} thanks again, the one who saves me, my God.
en.R: I tell myself: Why are you so sad? Why are you so upset? Keep hoping in God! I will praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} again. He saves me. He is my God.

fr.L: Pourquoi es-tu abattue, mon âme, et pourquoi gémis-tu au-dedans de moi ? Espère en Dieu, car je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louerai encore, le salut de ma face et mon Dieu.
fr.B: Pourquoi es-tu si abattue, mon âme ? Pourquoi ce trouble au-dedans de moi ? Espère en Dieu ; je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} rendrai grâce encore, à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui me sauve, mon Dieu.
fr.R: Je me dis : Pourquoi es-tu si triste ? Pourquoi es-tu si inquiet ? Continue d’espérer en Dieu ! Je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louerai encore. Il me sauve. Il est mon Dieu.

sw.L: Mbona umeinama, nafsi yangu, na mbona unafadhaika ndani yangu? Mngojee Mungu, kwa maana bado nitamshukuru {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, wokovu wa uso wangu na Mungu wangu.
sw.B: Mbona umeinama hivyo, nafsi yangu? Mbona huku kuhangaika ndani yangu? Mngojee Mungu kwa tumaini; nitamshukuru tena, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayeniokoa, Mungu wangu.
sw.R: Ninajiambia: Mbona una huzuni hivyo? Mbona umefadhaika hivyo? Endelea kumtumaini Mungu! Nitamsifu tena. Yeye huniokoa. Yeye ni Mungu wangu.

es.L: ¿Por qué estás abatida, alma mía, y por qué te turbas dentro de mí? Espera en Dios, porque aún {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} daré gracias, la salvación de mi rostro y mi Dios.
es.B: ¿Por qué te doblegas tanto, alma mía? ¿Por qué esta inquietud dentro de mí? Espera en Dios con esperanza; otra vez {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} daré gracias, a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, que me salva, mi Dios.
es.R: Me digo a mí mismo: ¿Por qué estás tan triste? ¿Por qué estás tan preocupado? ¡Sigue esperando en Dios! Otra vez {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} alabaré. Él me salva. Él es mi Dios.

vi.L: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, sao lại cúi rạp xuống, và sao lại xao xuyến trong tôi? Hãy trông đợi Đức Chúa Trời, vì tôi sẽ còn cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là sự cứu rỗi của mặt tôi và là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.B: Hỡi linh hồn tôi, sao lại gục ngã đến thế? Sao lại bồn chồn trong tôi? Hãy hy vọng nơi Đức Chúa Trời; tôi sẽ lại cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là Đấng cứu tôi, là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.
vi.R: Tôi tự nhủ: Sao lại buồn đến thế? Sao lại bối rối đến thế? Hãy cứ hy vọng nơi Đức Chúa Trời! Tôi sẽ lại ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài cứu tôi. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi.

ko.L: 내 영혼아, 네가 어찌하여 낙심하며, 어찌하여 내 속에서 소란하냐? 하나님을 기다려라. 내가 여전히 그분께 감사할 것이다. [그분은] 내 얼굴의 구원이시요 나의 하나님이시다.
ko.B: 내 영혼아, 어찌하여 그렇게 낙심하느냐? 어찌하여 내 속에서 이렇게 불안해하느냐? 하나님께 소망을 두어라. 나를 구원하시는 분, 나의 하나님께 내가 다시 감사할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 나 자신에게 말한다. 왜 그렇게 슬퍼하느냐? 왜 그렇게 불안해하느냐? 하나님께 계속 희망을 두어라! 나는 다시 그분을 찬양할 것이다. 그분께서 나를 구원하신다. 그분은 나의 하나님이시다.

pt.L: Por que você está abatida, ó minha alma, e por que se agita dentro de mim? Espere em Deus, pois ainda darei graças a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, a salvação da minha face e o meu Deus.
pt.B: Por que você está tão abatida, ó minha alma? Por que essa agitação dentro de mim? Espere em Deus; ainda darei graças a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, aquele que me salva, o meu Deus.
pt.R: Eu digo a mim mesmo: Por que você está tão triste? Por que está tão inquieto? Continue esperando em Deus! Ainda vou louvá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}. Ele me salva. Ele é o meu Deus.

am.L: ነፍሴ ሆይ፣ ለምን አቀረቀርሽ? በውስጤስ ለምን ትታወኪያለሽ? እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርጊ፤ የፊቴ መድኃኒትና አምላኬ የሆነውን ገና አመሰግነዋለሁና።
am.B: ነፍሴ ሆይ፣ ለምን እንዲህ አቀረቀርሽ? ይህስ ውስጣዊ ሁከት ለምንድን ነው? እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርገሽ ጠብቂ፤ እርሱን፣ የሚያድነኝን አምላኬን፣ እንደ ገና አመሰግነዋለሁ።
am.R: ነፍሴን እንዲህ እላታለሁ፦ ለምን እንዲህ አዘንሽ? ለምንስ እንዲህ ተረበሽሽ? በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ማድረግሽን አታቋርጪ! እንደ ገና አመሰግነዋለሁ። እርሱ ያድነኛል፤ እርሱ አምላኬ ነው።

hi.L: हे मेरे प्राण, तुम क्यों झुके हुए हो, और क्यों मेरे भीतर व्याकुल हो? परमेश्वर की बाट जोहो, क्योंकि मैं फिर उनका धन्यवाद करूँगा, जो मेरे मुख का उद्धार और मेरे परमेश्वर हैं।
hi.B: हे मेरे प्राण, तुम इतने क्यों झुक गए हो? मेरे भीतर यह बेचैनी क्यों है? आशा रखकर परमेश्वर की बाट जोहो; मैं फिर उनका धन्यवाद करूँगा, जो मुझे बचाते हैं, जो मेरे परमेश्वर हैं।
hi.R: मैं अपने आप से कहता हूँ: तुम इतने उदास क्यों हो? तुम इतने बेचैन क्यों हो? परमेश्वर पर आशा रखे रहो! मैं फिर उनकी स्तुति करूँगा। वे मुझे बचाते हैं। वे मेरे परमेश्वर हैं।

ru.L: Почему ты поникла, душа моя, и почему ты в смятении во мне? Жди Бога, ведь я ещё буду благодарить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, спасение лица моего и Бога моего.
ru.B: Почему ты так поникла, душа моя? Откуда во мне эта тревога? Жди Бога с надеждой: я снова буду благодарить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, того, кто спасает меня, моего Бога.
ru.R: Я говорю себе: почему ты так грустишь? Почему ты так тревожишься? Продолжай надеяться на Бога! Я снова буду хвалить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Он спасает меня. Он — мой Бог.

ja.L: わたしの魂よ、なぜ、おまえはうなだれているのか？なぜ、わたしの内で思い乱れているのか？神を待ち望め。まことに、わたしはなお、その方に感謝する。わたしの顔の救い、わたしの神に。
ja.B: わたしの魂よ、なぜ、そんなにうなだれているのか？なぜ、わたしの内で騒ぎ立つのか？神に望みを置いて、待ちなさい。わたしは再び、その方に感謝する。わたしを救ってくださる方、わたしの神に。
ja.R: わたしは自分に言い聞かせる。なぜ、そんなに悲しんでいるのか？なぜ、そんなに心が騒ぐのか？神に望みを置き続けなさい！わたしは、もう一度その方に感謝の歌を歌う。その方は、わたしを救ってくださる。その方こそ、わたしの神だ。

uk.L: Чому ти зігнулася, моя душе, і чому ти тривожишся в мені? Чекай на Бога, бо я ще дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, спасінню мого обличчя і моєму Богові.
uk.B: Чому ти так низько схилилася, моя душе? Чому цей неспокій у мені? З надією чекай на Бога; я знову дякуватиму {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, тому, хто спасає мене, моєму Богові.
uk.R: Я кажу собі: Чому ти такий сумний? Чому ти такий стривожений? Надійся й далі на Бога! Я знову хвалитиму {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Він спасає мене. Він — мій Бог.

decisions.choice: my soul: the psalmist speaks to himself
decisions.reason: The refrain is a conversation inside the psalmist: one part of him asks why his soul is so low and urges it to hope. Soul (nefesh) is the whole self, here his own heart.

decisions.choice: bowed down, in turmoil: crushed and restless
decisions.reason: The first verb (shachach) is to be bent low, sunk down; the second (hamah) is the roaring or restlessness of the sea, which the poem pictures in 42:8.

decisions.choice: the salvation of my face: the one who saves me in person
decisions.reason: The plural "salvations" (yeshu'ot) means full rescue. "My face" stands for the person: God is the one who saves him and lifts his face again.

decisions.choice: I tell myself: Why are you ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that he is speaking to himself (m1).
The same words as 42:12. The third refrain now follows a prayer and a vow of praise (verses 3-4), so its hope sounds stronger.
The Hebrew repeats 42:12 exactly (m4), so each level repeats the Portuguese of 42:12, with the soul addressed as "você" as decided at 42:6.

decisions.choice: the refrain in exactly the Amharic of 42:12
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of 43:5 is the same as 42:12, so the Amharic is the same at every level.

decisions.choice: one wording of the refrain per level in 42:6, 42:12 and 43:5; the soul addressed as तुम
decisions.reason: Psalms 42 and 43 are one poem with one refrain (42:6, 42:12, 43:5), so each level words it the same way in all three places; 42:6 differs only where its Hebrew does ("the salvation of his face" for "the salvation of my face and my God", and no second "why", supplied in brackets at Literal). The psalmist speaks to his own soul. Hindi तू is kept for speech to God in this translation, so the soul is addressed with तुम (झुके हुए हो, जोहो); the soul (प्राण) is masculine. Readable makes the self-address plain with मैं अपने आप से कहता हूँ, as the English does.
The refrain has one wording at each level in its three places (42:6, 42:12, 43:5); this one is word for word 42:12.

decisions.choice: The refrain word for word as 42:12
decisions.reason: The refrain closes the poem (m4); the Hebrew is the same as 42:12.
